title: SWEC iEEG Dataset
description: Long-term pre-surgical intracranial EEG (iEEG) recordings from 50 patients with pharmacoresistant epilepsy, collected at the Sleep-Wake-Epilepsy-Center (SWEC), Inselspital, University of Bern, in collaboration with ETH Zurich. The dataset comprises about 6672 hours of continuous, fully anonymized iEEG with 460 expert-annotated seizures. It is converted to BIDS from the public SWEC-ETHZ release and the authors' Hugging Face release.
methods_description: Intracranial strip, grid and depth electrodes were recorded with 16-bit analog-to-digital conversion at 512 or 1024 Hz. Signals were band-pass filtered at 0.5-150 Hz (4th-order Butterworth, zero-phase) and median-referenced. Artifact channels were removed at the source. Seizure onsets and offsets were annotated by a board-certified epileptologist. Source HDF5 data were losslessly converted to BrainVision format in BIDS.
